drawer.comment: Deeper and softer than card — a drawer floats over the page, a card sits in it. From events-ui .app-drawer.

cardHover.comment: ONLY the dashboard region mini-cards lift on hover. Hero and chart cards deliberately do not — see dashboard.mybky.

xs.comment: Figma "XS Drop Shadow". Resting elevation for a 40px stepper slot.

xl.comment: Figma "XL Drop Shadow". The lifted stepper slot — active, and inactive-on-hover.

xs.comment: Figma "XS Drop Shadow" (#10182826, y1, blur2, spread0). The lift under a listing table's outer frame — Sampark Portal 17512:73144.

s.comment: Figma "S Drop Shadow" — the lift under the slider value bubble (node 13197:89384). Promoted out of slider.component.ts, which had it inlined because no sampark shadow token matched. Note this is the same pair as shadow.mybky.switchThumb; the value was already in the file under a name that gave no hint it was a general S-level drop shadow.

xl.comment: Figma "XL Drop Shadow" — the lift under the Alert notification card (node 13197:89157). Promoted out of alert.component.ts.

dropdown.comment: Every floating panel in the Sampark Portal — select/multiselect overlays, popovers, column-config panels — carries this one shadow. Sharing it is what makes them read as one surface family; sampark.overlay (PrimeNG's three-layer stock value) does not appear in the design.

drawer.comment: Sampark Portal filter drawer (Figma 17512:72588). Deeper/softer than l1+l2 — a drawer floats over the whole page, not a card.
